offerings.name: Agent Runtime Governance Assessment
offerings.buyer_hypothesis: An operator or technical owner responsible for a specific AI workflow.
offerings.problem_hypothesis: Unclear action boundaries, ineffective controls, or insufficient evidence of actual effects.
offerings.minimum_bounded_deliverable: Assessment of one declared workflow, with a protected-boundary inventory, control-gap findings, evidence limits, and scoped remediation proposals.
offerings.fit_rationale: Packages boundary mapping and verification as an assessment deliverable. Deliverability depends on a defined assessment method and access; the candidate supplies no proven runtime guarantee.
viability_conditions: Buyer can provide a bounded workflow and permitted read/test access.
Findings must be actionable and supported by observations.
Customer validates that the assessment resolves a worthwhile uncertainty.
defeat_conditions: The buyer obtains no sufficient value from the assessment.

resource_implications.build: Define assessment method, evidence requirements, and reporting format.
resource_implications.validation: Qualify controls and false-acceptance checks on admitted specimens.
resource_implications.integration: Obtain scoped access and inventory protected boundaries.
resource_implications.delivery_support: Reviewer effort, findings review, and correction lineage.

offerings.next_information_object: A scoped assessment specification and customer problem-validation record; no outreach or execution is authorized by this menu.

offerings.name: Governed Workflow Pilot
offerings.buyer_hypothesis: An operations owner seeking controlled automation for one repeatable workflow.
offerings.problem_hypothesis: Manual supervision, drift, interruptions, and false completion limit useful automation.
offerings.minimum_bounded_deliverable: A separately admitted pilot for one workflow with declared intent, effects, constraints, witnessing, recovery, and escalation.
offerings.fit_rationale: Combines the candidate's control-loop mechanisms into a bounded operational embodiment; the evidence and implementation burden spans multiple unvalidated features.
viability_conditions: Exact workflow, constraints, success criterion, and authority envelope are bound.
Relevant controls and witnesses are qualified.
A matched customer baseline permits evaluation of supervision, rework, completion, and cost.
defeat_conditions: Useful completion does not improve within the accepted cost/risk envelope.
Integration effort exceeds justified customer value.
Controls or recovery fail their declared requirements.

resource_implications.build: Implement the bounded harness, adapters, persistence, controls, and operator interface.
resource_implications.validation: H01 plus separate feature-specific and boundary tests; H01 alone does not validate all features.
resource_implications.integration: Customer workflow, tool identity, permissions, and deployment environment.
resource_implications.delivery_support: Monitoring, escalation ownership, incident response, and maintenance.

offerings.next_information_object: A candidate pilot envelope and evidence-gap plan; pilot admission and dispatch require separate authority.

offerings.name: Workflow Evidence and Continuity Module
offerings.buyer_hypothesis: A team that needs traceability, verified completion, or recoverable workflow state.
offerings.problem_hypothesis: Success reports are hard to verify and interrupted work is difficult to reconstruct.
offerings.minimum_bounded_deliverable: A bounded module for an agreed workflow that records provenance and supports independently checked completion or recovery.
offerings.fit_rationale: Explores modular packaging of evidence and continuity capabilities; technical separability and interoperability remain unresolved.
viability_conditions: Dependencies can be isolated behind an accepted interface.
Evidence and recovery semantics match the customer's workflow.
The module's overhead and maintenance burden are acceptable.
defeat_conditions: Required features cannot be separated without the full harness.
Recorded evidence is insufficient for the customer's decision.
Overhead or integration cost exceeds the supported benefit.

resource_implications.build: Define module interfaces, evidence retention, and state/recovery contracts.
resource_implications.validation: Test false completion, recovery, provenance, access controls, and any portability claim separately.
resource_implications.integration: Adapters, event identity, storage, and customer access policies.
resource_implications.delivery_support: Retention, trace review, incident reconstruction, and version compatibility.

offerings.next_information_object: A feature-separability and interface proposal; no portability or recovery guarantee is earned by this projection.

tradeoffs: O01 can be specified around bounded assessment evidence; it still requires a qualified method and access.
O02 combines more candidate features and therefore carries a broader validation and integration scope.
O03 depends on separability and interoperability that have not been established.
shared_dependencies: F01/F04/F06 recur across offerings; implementation, validation, and resource needs must be accounted for once at the shared-dependency level.
No demand, effort, pricing, or revenue ranking is established.

founder_isolation_surface.dependency_limit: Requires exact postconditions, independent witness binding, and evidence/access contracts.
Requires inventory scope and a qualified assessment method.
Coupled controls, recovery, escalation, and customer-specific validation remain necessary.

unresolved_inputs: scientific and operational evidence required for each offer
next_information_object: Founder may identify a feature or offering for further scoping; an actual resource commitment requires its own recorded decision.
